consent.title: AI Chat
consent.headline: AI-Powered Bible Study
consent.lead: Verdance uses advanced artificial intelligence (Claude by Anthropic) to provide instant theological insights, chapter summaries, and flashcard generation.
consent.providerSummary: Your questions and uploaded study documents are processed securely through Anthropic's Claude API. Responses are generated to help you explore Scripture, cross-references, and historical contexts.
consent.featuresNote: Our AI features require an active network connection and will consume study credits from your balance.
consent.warningBody: AI assistants are study tools, not spiritual authorities. Always compare AI-generated insights against Scripture and consult trusted church leadership.
consent.declineMessage: You can use all other features of Verdance without the AI assistant. You can change this choice at any time in Settings.
consent.declinedInfo: AI Assistant is currently turned off based on your privacy preference. You can enable it at any time in Settings.
consent.blurb: Ask questions and get instant answers with Bible verses to guide your study.
consent.accuracy: Answers are generated by AI and may not always be accurate. Verify important interpretations with your pastor or a trusted commentary.
consent.dataNote: Your messages are processed by third-party AI services to create responses. Please don’t share sensitive personal information.
consent.dataWhat: The questions and messages you type, and any PDF or image you attach.
consent.dataWho: Our AI providers — OpenRouter and Anthropic (Claude) — receive it to generate responses. Please don’t share sensitive personal information.
consent.shortNotice: The questions you type and any file you attach are sent to our AI providers (OpenRouter and Anthropic) to generate results. Continue?
